title: DS identifiers over Unicode
preamble:
# DS identifiers over Unicode

**Prefix `LNAM`.** The identifier surface: which characters an identifier may
contain, when two identifiers denote the same name, Unicode normalization, script
security, bidirectional-text safety, and the wire / determinism contract for names.

**Paired with:** positional type classification — how a `NAME` is classified as a
type reference or a binding by grammatical **position** — in [LGRA];
and the `::` conversion operator in [LCST]. The lexer/LALR
realization of the `NAME` / `TYPE_SYM` terminals is [LLEX]'s. This
doc owns `LNAM.1`, `LNAM.2`, and `LNAM.7`.

**Depends on:** [LDET] (the version series that keeps artefacts of
different Unicode pins apart), [LNUL.6], [RFCS] (schema
names on the wire).
